releaseNotes:
• Instant Library Sync: Magazine download button automatically flips to 'পড়ুন' (Read) instantly without leaving tab
• Non-Blocking Online Streaming: Dismissible progress dialog with 'বাতিল করুন' (Cancel) and 'ব্যাকগ্রাউন্ডে ডাউনলোড' options
• Robust Crash Prevention: Atomic downloads with .part files, automatic PDF integrity verification, and safe memory management
• Safe Deletion & Redownload: Complete cache wipe on deletion prevents corrupted or truncated file crashes
